# 88th Drama League Awards

| venue = The Ziegfeld Ballroom
}}
The 88th Drama League Awards were held on May 20, 2022, recognizing excellence in Broadway and Off-Broadway productions during the 2021–22 season. Nominations were announced on April 25, 2022, with The Music Man, Company, Six, and Funny Girl leading the nominations, with four each.
Winners and nominees
The 2021-2022 Drama League Awards nominations were announced on Monday, April 25, 2022, by Denée Benton and André de Shields at the New York Public Library.
*Billy Crystal - Contribution to the Theatre Award
*Hugh Jackman - Distinguished Achievement in Musical Theatre
*Lileana Blain-Cruz -  Founders Award for Excellence in Directing
*Willette Murphy Klausner - Gratitude Award
Winners included Company, which received Outstanding Revival of a Musical and Outstanding Director of Musical; The Lehman Trilogy, which won Outstanding Production of a Play; A Strange Loop, which earned Outstanding Production of a Musical and Take Me Out which won Outstanding Revival of a Play. The Drama League Award for Distinguished Performance was awarded to Sutton Foster for her performance in The Music Man.
